## Topics (NMF top terms)

0. **Credit-report accuracy / debt (FCRA)**: reporting, debt, information, consumer, fcra, credit reporting, act, inaccurate, fair, violation
1. **FCRA legal template ('15 USC 1681')**: section, section states, usc, usc section, states, consumer, furnish account, states consumer, right privacy, account written
2. **Unauthorized hard inquiries**: credit report, report, inquiry, inquiries, hard, hard inquiry, inquiry credit, hard inquiries, inquiries credit, removed
3. **Fraud-platform template**: unfair, resolution, financial, platform leaving, measures prevent, vulnerable unprotected, fraud platform, unprotected, prevent address, effective measures
4. **Late payments & fees**: late, payment, payments, late payment, fees, fee, paid, balance, late payments, month
5. **Card account, limits & closures**: card, credit card, cards, balance, use, closed, limit, used, score, card account
6. **Deposits, transfers & frozen funds**: money, bank, funds, check, checking, deposit, transfer, checking account, deposited, closed
7. **Identity theft**: identity, theft, identity theft, victim, victim identity, accounts, opened, theft account, account identity, fraudulent
8. **Transaction disputes & refunds**: dispute, claim, transaction, refund, charges, charge, merchant, transactions, fraud, filed
9. **Account-closure template**: closed account, job properly, doing job, sure mistake, email linked, mistake assume, closed, feel doing, deal used, report feel
10. **Auto & mortgage loans**: loan, mortgage, car, home, paid, pay, vehicle, payments, years, auto
11. **Customer service & promotions**: customer, service, customer service, email, issue, bonus, offer, representative, receive, supervisor
